title: Your Brain Is Editing Your Memories

scenes.narration: Your brain is editing your memories right now.
scenes.caption: YOUR BRAIN IS EDITING\nYOUR MEMORIES

scenes.narration: And you probably don't even realize it's happening.
scenes.caption: YOU DON'T EVEN\nREALIZE IT

scenes.narration: When you remember something, your brain doesn't simply replay a recording.
scenes.caption: MEMORY IS NOT A RECORDING

scenes.narration: It reconstructs the memory from pieces of information.
scenes.caption: YOUR BRAIN RECONSTRUCTS IT

scenes.narration: That means every time you remember something, the memory can actually change.
scenes.caption: EVERY RECALL CAN CHANGE IT

scenes.narration: That's one reason two people can remember the same event differently.
scenes.caption: SAME EVENT. DIFFERENT MEMORY.

scenes.narration: So your memories aren't perfect recordings. They're reconstructions.
scenes.caption: YOUR MEMORIES ARE RECONSTRUCTIONS.
